long_biography.plain_text:
Meshal Al Marzouq's stewardship of Tamdeen Real Estate covered a period when the company deepened its role in Kuwait's retail landscape. As non-executive chairman, he helped set strategy, capital structure and governance while subsidiaries developed shopping, leisure and mixed-use destinations. He also chaired and led Tamdeen Investment, bringing financial-services experience to a group organised around property and investment assets.

Al Marzouq's interest in Ferrari began at his sister's wedding in the 1980s, when she received a blue 412. After studying in the United States, he bought his first Ferrari in his early twenties and developed a collection shaped by V12 cars and bespoke specifications. He has described their power through the image of holding a horse ready to break into motion.
